reason: Product names and prices from a catalog describe merchandise, not people or customers.
sql: SELECT name, price FROM catalog.products ORDER BY name LIMIT 20

reason: Subscription plan names with their list price are the provider's own offer.
sql: SELECT name, monthly_price_cents FROM billing.plans ORDER BY monthly_price_cents

reason: Pending work per internal queue name is operational metadata.
sql: SELECT queue_name, count(*) AS pending FROM jobs.job_runs WHERE status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY queue_name

reason: A notification template name read from campaign settings names a message layout, not a recipient.
sql: SELECT id, settings->>'template_name' AS template FROM notifications.campaigns LIMIT 10

reason: Event names counted across the product are usage statistics, not personal data.
sql: SELECT event_name, count(*) AS n FROM analytics.events GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

reason: Feature flag names and their state are application configuration.
sql: SELECT name, enabled FROM config.feature_flags ORDER BY name

reason: Display names of merchant category codes are a public classification.
sql: SELECT code, display_name FROM payments.merchant_categories ORDER BY code

reason: The name of each recently created user identifies people.
sql: SELECT id, name FROM app.users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

reason: Card holder names are personal data, whatever the card fields around them.
sql: SELECT last4, holder_name FROM payments.cards WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day'

reason: Counting users with a given name tells the requester whether that person has an account.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM app.users WHERE name = 'Synthetic Person'

reason: Employee names with their team identify people and their position.
sql: SELECT e.name, e.team FROM hr.employees e ORDER BY e.team

reason: An account's display name is usually its owner's name or chosen handle.
sql: SELECT id, display_name FROM app.accounts LIMIT 50

reason: The legal names of merchants disclose which companies are customers.
sql: SELECT id, legal_name FROM payments.merchants WHERE country = 'FR' LIMIT 20

reason: Payout amounts next to beneficiary names reveal what a named person received.
sql: SELECT p.amount_cents, b.name FROM payments.payouts p JOIN payments.beneficiaries b ON b.id = p.beneficiary_id LIMIT 20

reason: Customer organizations listed by display name and plan disclose the client base.
sql: SELECT display_name, plan FROM crm.organizations ORDER BY display_name LIMIT 30
